patterns.label: Application shell dimensions
patterns.note: Existing 248/80px navigation and workspace/review geometry tokens; responsive diagram remains a documented extension.

patterns.label: Expanded and collapsed navigation
patterns.note: Source row, grouping, count, selected, hover and focus composition; preview links select locally.

patterns.label: Fund identity and collapse control
patterns.note: Single-fund identity and one persistent collapse action. No obsolete source workspace switcher is introduced.

patterns.label: Profile trigger and account menu
patterns.note: Avatar/name/email trigger and identity heading; actual links and sign-out action; arrow-key, Escape, Tab, outside-click and focus restoration.

patterns.label: Navigation icon controls
patterns.note: Shared Phosphor/Button implementation composed into source 30px toggle geometry and navigation shadow.

patterns.label: Icon/title/subtitle/action heading
patterns.note: Reusable heading helper; source decorative image assets normalized to Phosphor while preserving hierarchy.

patterns.label: Profile name/email form
patterns.note: Native name/email form, save feedback, session and workspace rows; example state only.

patterns.label: Settings definition rows and tags
patterns.note: Source label/value alignment, icon, wrapping category tags, divided rows and muted thesis panel.

patterns.label: Settings danger section
patterns.note: Source-style description/action row with local sample-reset action; destructive confirmation remains existing alert-dialog.

patterns.label: Scheduling URL setting
patterns.note: URL field, HTTPS validation, save/remove and empty disabled remove state.

patterns.label: Team management rows
patterns.note: Identity, email, role, pending/active badge and local remove action in Settings composition; not a new Data table style.

patterns.label: API key management rows
patterns.note: Label, fake prefix, date/status and local revoke action; copyable fake value. No real credential generation.

patterns.label: Repeated invitation controls
patterns.note: Email/person icon, shared role select, remove and Add another; unique IDs and native email validation.

patterns.label: Numeric min/max currency group
patterns.note: Shared select/number/checkbox atoms, No preference disables all controls, group validation, error association and local save.

patterns.label: Multiple preference picker
patterns.note: Searchable rounds/sectors/geography with clear, empty results and exclusive No preference behavior; normalized listbox semantics.

patterns.label: Logo upload and preview
patterns.note: PNG/JPEG/WebP file chooser and selected local image preview; object URLs revoked on cleanup. No upload service.

patterns.label: Invitation and readonly email
patterns.note: Name, invited email readonly, sign-in button, divider and submit action; the sign-in action explicitly stays a preview.

patterns.label: Onboarding split composition
patterns.note: Four configurations compose the shared fields; workspace name/thesis update a contextual side preview. Source scenic/glass art is deliberately normalized, not claimed pixel-identical.

patterns.label: Readonly, invalid, required and disabled fields
patterns.note: Source group-level errors and disabled numeric fields plus existing Input/Form-field states. No source password screen exists in these routes; the existing Input password variation is an extension.

patterns.label: Modal structure and footer
patterns.note: Existing native-dialog family covers generic heading, close, scroll body, width and footer; source focus behavior normalized to native dialog.

patterns.label: Destructive confirmations
patterns.note: Existing shared confirmation with soft intent action covers reset/delete/revoke confirmation bodies.

patterns.label: Invite, role, key and fund form dialogs
patterns.note: Source form bodies are available as invite/fund/key/role configurations using shared fields/custom selects and native dialog lifecycle.

patterns.label: Company-context decision dialog
patterns.note: Company identity, optional/required reason, source compact 400px/20px modal geometry; scenic hero normalized to tokenized identity region.

patterns.label: Scheduling step dialog
patterns.note: Required HTTPS URL and Skip/Save actions inside the shared contextual dialog.

patterns.label: Current decision action list
patterns.note: Interested/Watch/Pass choices with shared filled Phosphor icons, current marker and local selection feedback.

patterns.label: Copyable value and fallback
patterns.note: Readonly field, copy action, success status and selected-text fallback on unsupported/denied clipboard.

patterns.label: Integration setup composition
patterns.note: Collapsible identity header, sample URL, numbered instructions, accessible App/Code tabs, code block and information notice.

patterns.label: Document preview and unavailable states
patterns.note: Text/image/PDF/unsupported/unavailable configurations; selected local file preview, escaping, original download and object URL cleanup. No network upload.

patterns.label: Toast and undo feedback
patterns.note: Existing shared toast has live announcement, optional Undo and explicit dismissal.

patterns.label: Signed-out recovery state
patterns.note: User icon, status copy and local recovery action; no live account session.

patterns.label: Fund directory external-link card
patterns.note: Live source is one informational card/link, not the unreachable legacy Fund Index list branch.

patterns.label: Permission-dependent controls
patterns.note: Existing disabled/hidden-action patterns plus role examples represent the UI; actual authorization is separately nonvisual.

patterns.label: Account authentication and storage services
patterns.note: Live authorization/session, invitation email delivery, credential backend and file persistence are service behavior, not additional visual families. Specimens explicitly keep actions local; source app itself uses local demo data.
